Test Case Title: Valid locality/address submits and returns a results page
Test Steps: 1. Enter "Delhi" into the #OutletSearch field ("Search nearby branch/ATMs by locality"). 2. Click Search.
Expected Result: Form submits via GET to ?search=Delhi; page loads without error; matching branches/ATMs render.
Actual Result / Remarks: Navigated to https://nearme.ujjivansfb.bank.in/?search=Delhi; 5 outlets rendered on the results page.

Test Case Title: Empty submission is blocked by required-field validation
Test Steps: 1. Clear the #OutletSearch field. 2. Attempt to submit the form (native browser validation, not a manual click needed).
Expected Result: Native HTML5 required validation blocks submission; form does not navigate.
Actual Result / Remarks: checkValidity() === false on the empty field; field carries the required attribute.

Test Case Title: Nonsense/no-match input is handled gracefully, no crash
Test Steps: 1. Enter a nonsense string with no matching branch ("zzqxnonexistentplace9999"). 2. Click Search.
Expected Result: Page loads normally (no 500 / blank page); shows zero results rather than crashing.
Actual Result / Remarks: Navigated successfully; 0 outlets rendered — no error page, no crash.

Test Case Title: Script-injection payload is not executed or reflected
Expected Result: No script executes, no JS dialog fires, payload is not rendered unescaped in the response.
Actual Result / Remarks: No script execution detected (window.__xssMarker not set), no dialog triggered.

Expected Result: State dropdown lists all expected states (26 non-empty options).
Actual Result / Remarks: 26 state options found, including Delhi and Karnataka.

Test Case Title: Selecting a State repopulates the City dropdown
Test Steps: Select a State (e.g. Andhra Pradesh) and wait for the AJAX call.
Expected Result: City <select> options change from the default placeholder to that state's cities.
Actual Result / Remarks: City options changed after selecting state=andhra-pradesh (AJAX repopulation confirmed).

Test Case Title: Submitting with no State selected is blocked
Preconditions: Store locator homepage loaded, State left blank
Test Steps: Reset #OutletState to blank and attempt to submit.
Expected Result: Submission is blocked — either by native validation or by the site's own JS (no navigation, inline error shown).
Actual Result / Remarks: No "required" attribute on this client's State field (checkValidity()=true), but the site's own JS blocked the submit: page stayed on the same URL and the inline message "Please either enter your nearby locality or select your state first" became visible. Note for testers: don't rely on checkValidity() alone for this client — the block is JS-driven, not native HTML5.

Test Steps: 1. Select State = Delhi. 2. Leave City, Locality, Radius untouched. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Page navigates to a state-scoped results view; branches/ATMs in that state render.

Test Steps: 1. Select State = Delhi. 2. Select City = New Delhi (populated via AJAX after State). 3. Leave Locality/Radius untouched. 4. Submit.
Expected Result: Page navigates to a state+city-scoped results view.

Preconditions: State = Delhi, City = New Delhi selected
Test Steps: 1. Select State = Delhi, City = New Delhi. 2. Type "Shadipur" into the Locality field (enabled only once a City is chosen). 3. Leave Radius untouched. 4. Submit.
Expected Result: Page navigates with state/city/locality query params; results narrow to that locality.
Actual Result / Remarks: Navigated to https://nearme.ujjivansfb.bank.in/?state_name=Delhi&city_name=New%20Delhi&locality_name=Shadipur&radius=; 5 outlets rendered (down from 6 at city level) — narrowing confirmed with a real branch locality (Ujjivan Small Finance Bank - Shadipur Branch is a genuine listed outlet).

Test Case Title: Search with State + City + Locality + Radius
Preconditions: State = Delhi, City = New Delhi, Locality = Shadipur entered
Test Steps: 1. With State/City/Locality set as above, select Radius = 3 KM (the Radius field is disabled/placeholder-gated until Locality is non-empty). 2. Submit.
Expected Result: Page navigates with radius param added; result count narrows further to outlets within that radius.
Actual Result / Remarks: Navigated to https://nearme.ujjivansfb.bank.in/?state_name=Delhi&city_name=New%20Delhi&locality_name=Shadipur&radius=3; 1 outlet rendered (down from 5 at locality-only level) — radius genuinely narrows results further.
